# TShare

> One 4-digit key. Anything inside. TShare is a free, no-registration file and message sharing platform. Share text, images, and files instantly using a memorable 4-digit code, then anyone with the code can view or download the content from any device. Optional validity controls (no limit, viewable once, or 6 hours) auto-remove expired shares. The platform also offers realtime public chat rooms, premium codes with password protection and a content dashboard, and an organization module that lets businesses collect files and messages from customers via a printed QR code.

## What TShare offers

- Instant text, image, and file sharing via 4-digit codes with no sign-up required.
- Validity controls per share: no limit (default), viewable only once, or valid for 6 hours. Expired or consumed shares are removed automatically.
- Realtime public chat rooms with 4-digit room codes — WebSocket messaging, emoji picker, typing indicators, and user presence.
- Premium codes: exclusive custom 4 or 6 character keys, display names, password protection, and a management dashboard. Codes are valid for 30 days and renewable.
- Organization module: businesses register an org, get a 4-character alpha code + QR, and let customers anonymously hand over text, images, and files to an org dashboard.
- Full admin panel for managing shared content, users, public rooms, premium codes, and site stats.
- Created by Aman Sharma. Built on React + Node.js + Express, Socket.io, MongoDB, Cloudflare R2, and Redis/Valkey.

## Key Pages

- [Home — tshare.in](https://tshare.in/): landing page with the quick-share flow.
- [Share Text](https://tshare.in/share): create a text share and get a 4-digit code.
- [Share Image](https://tshare.in/share-image): upload and share an image (up to 5 MB).
- [Share File](https://tshare.in/share-file): upload and share files (up to 50 MB).
- [Receive](https://tshare.in/receive): enter a code to view or download shared content.
- [Public Rooms](https://tshare.in/public-room): join or create realtime chat rooms with a room code.
- [Dashboard](https://tshare.in/dashboard): account area for personalizing your sharing history.
- [Buy Premium](https://tshare.in/buy): purchase premium codes with custom keys, password protection, and a content dashboard.
- [Premium Login](https://tshare.in/premium/login): login for premium code owners.
- [Org Register](https://tshare.in/org/register): register an organization to collect customer content via QR.
- [Org Login](https://tshare.in/org/login): login for organization admins.
- [About](https://tshare.in/about): story, features, and tech stack.
- [Contact](https://tshare.in/contact): get in touch with the TShare team.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tshare.in/privacy-policy): how data is handled and stored.
- [Terms of Service](https://tshare.in/terms-of-service): usage terms and validity rules.
- [Account Deletion](https://tshare.in/account-delete): request permanent deletion of your account, history, premium codes and associated files; reviewed by the team within about 5 business days.

## How sharing works

1. Choose what to share — text, image, or file — and optionally set a validity (1-time or 6 hours).
2. Receive a unique 4-digit code and share it through any channel.
3. The recipient enters the code on tshare.in and instantly sees the shared content.

## Notes

- Sharing works without registration; an optional username only personalizes your sharing history.
- Image uploads are capped at 5 MB; file uploads at 50 MB.
- Account deletion (Google Play compliance): users can request permanent account deletion at /account-delete. Deletion removes the account, its share/receive history, owned premium codes and their stored files, and payment records tied to the account (except where retention is legally required, e.g. accounting/tax). Anonymously shared public content and content already received by others is not removed — it is governed by its own expiry settings. Deletion requests are reviewed by an admin before the account is purged.
